blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
**Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity.
  **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses.
  **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance.
  **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.
blocks.zh:
**目的:**超声波生物测量在各种临床应用中被广泛使用,包括产前和心脏检查,通过将卡利佩斯放入解剖地标来得到定量测量. 然而,这些测量仍然受到操作间变异性的影响,因为它们主要依靠手动卡路里定位. 常规方法往往使用专门的预测头来完成不同的超声波任务,而视觉语言模型则通过文本指示提供灵活性. 然而,直接的坐标预测没有明确的模拟空间概率分布,限制了本地化模糊性的表现.
** 方法:** 我们提出Kev-Bio,一种用临床测量问题指导超声波地标探测的视觉语言模型. Kev-Bio在System One决定模型的启发下,使用语言模型的决定表示来生成每个卡利珀端点的查询. 这些查询与共享的密集超声波特征相匹配,生成空间概率图,从中得出地标坐标和临床测量. 该模型是经过培训的端到端,既使用地标化本地化,又使用临床测量损失.
** 成果:** 在九景FU/GU Biometery 2026数据集上,Kev-Bio实现了22.50像素的平均射线误差(MRE)和15.38的临床测量平均绝对误差(MAE),在整体性能上超过了比较基线.
** 结论:** 这些结果显示了Kev-Bio在超声波地标检测和临床测量中在不同解剖观点上的有效性. 我们的代码和模型可查阅https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ultrasound is widely used to examine anatomy during routine care and to guide clinical procedures. It provides real-time images without exposing patients to ionizing radiation Ceriani et al. (2025) . Beyond visual assessment, many clinical examinations also require quantitative measurements of anatomical structures. These measurements are obtained by placing calipers at predefined landmarks and calculating distances, angles, or circumferences. Choosing the correct points requires knowledge of both anatomy and the measurement protocol. Although standardized training can yield high reproducibility, measurements can still differ between observers Donadono et al. (2022) . Automatic caliper placement could reduce this manual effort and make quantitative assessment more consistent Mor-Avi et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 超声波被广泛用于常规护理期间的解剖检查并指导临床程序. 它提供实时图像而不使患者暴露于电离辐射Ceriani等 (2025). 除了视觉评估外,许多临床检查还需要对解剖结构进行定量测量. 这些测量方法是将卡利佩斯放入预先确定的地标并计算出距离,角度,或环绕. 选择正确的分数需要同时了解解剖学和测量协议. 虽然标准化训练可以产生高可再生性,但观察者多纳多诺等(2022年)的测量仍然可以有所不同. 自动卡路里安放可以减少这种人工操作,并使定量评估更加一致的Mor-Avi等人(2023年)。

blocks.en:
Accurate anatomical landmark localization remains challenging in ultrasound imaging. Speckle noise, acoustic shadowing, and indistinct tissue boundaries can obscure anatomical structures, while changes in probe orientation alter their appearance. A single ultrasound image may support multiple clinical measurements, each requiring a distinct set of landmarks. Models developed for these tasks commonly use a shared image encoder with separate decoders or landmark-specific parameters Rasaee and Rivaz (2026) . Although these architectures can localize predefined landmarks, each measurement task remains tied to a fixed output head or task-specific parameter set, making adaptation to new anatomical structures or
measurement tasks challenging.
blocks.zh:
在超声波成像中,准确解剖地标本地化仍然具有挑战性. 光谱噪声,声学阴影,和模糊的组织界限会模糊解剖结构,而探测方向的变化会改变它们的外观. 单一的超声波图像可能支持多个临床测量,每个都需要一组独特的地标. 为这些任务所开发的模型通常使用一个共享的图像编码器,其中包含单独的解码器或地标特定参数Rasaee和Rivaz (2026). 虽然这些架构可以将预先定义的地标本地化,但每个测量任务仍与固定输出头或任务特定参数集相挂钩,使适应新的解剖结构或
衡量任务具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Previous studies have used multimodal language models to predict segmentation masks and point locations from text and image representations Lai et al. (2024) ; Jhang et al. (2026) . Ultrasound biometry, however, requires precise localization of multiple measurement endpoints, whose anatomical roles vary across tasks. The central challenge is to identify which endpoints a clinical instruction refers to and locate each endpoint accurately in the image within a shared framework.
blocks.zh: 以前的研究使用多模式语言模型,从文字和图像表述Lai等人(2024年);Jhang等人(2026年)预测分块口罩和分点位置。 然而,超声波生物测量需要精确地定位多个测量终点,其解剖作用因任务而异. 中心挑战是确定临床指示所指的终点,并在共同框架内准确定位图像中的每个终点。

blocks.en: Recent System One models, such as Jev Deußer et al. (2026) and its open-weight counterpart Kev Palmer (2026) , formulate prediction as scoring candidate responses rather than generating answers autoregressively. While primarily explored for decision-support tasks, this formulation offers potential for spatial localization by treating image locations as candidate responses to clinical localization questions.
blocks.zh: 最近的系统 一个模型,如Jev Deußer等人(2026年)及其开放重量对应的Kev Palmer(2026年),将预测作为考生的评分答复,而不是自动生成答案. 虽然主要探讨决策支持任务,但这种配方通过将图像位置作为临床局部化问题的候选答案,为空间局部化提供了潜力.

blocks.en:
Building on this insight, we introduce Kev-Bio , a unified framework that translates clinical measurement questions into landmark queries and grounds them in dense ultrasound features to localize anatomical landmarks. Specifically, we initialize Qwen3.5 with Kev Qwen Team (2026) ; Palmer (2026) to interpret
the ultrasound image and measurement instructions,
generating queries for the required anatomical landmarks. These queries interact with a shared dense feature map combining representations from Qwen3.5, USFM, and DINOv2 Qwen Team (2026) ; Jiao et al. (2024) ; Oquab et al. (2023) to produce landmark probability maps. The maps provide spatial information about localization ambiguity, while joint landmark and measurement supervision guides training. We evaluate this formulation across nine ultrasound views through comparisons with established methods and controlled ablation studies.
blocks.zh:
在这个洞察力的基础上,我们引入了Kev-Bio, 一个统一的框架,将临床测量问题转化为里程碑式的查询, 并将它们置于密集的超声波特征中, 以本地化解剖学地标。 具体地说,我们与克夫·克文团队(2026年);帕尔默(2026年)一起初始化了Quen3.5 来解释.
超声波图像和测量指令,
生成所需解剖地标的查询。 这些查询与共同密集的地物图相互作用,结合了从Quen3.5,USFM,和DINOv2 Quen Team(2026)的表示;由Jiao等(2024),Oquab等(2023)生成地标概率图. 这些地图提供了有关本地化模糊性的空间信息,而共同的地标和测量监督指导培训。 我们通过与既定方法进行比较和控制性衰减研究,对9个超声波观点评估这种配方。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Landmark detectors commonly predict coordinates or heatmaps at predefined anatomical points. nnLandmark provides a self-configuring approach to three-dimensional landmark detection, while MedSapiens adapts pose estimation representations to medical images Ertl et al. (2026) ; Elbatel et al. (2026) . For ultrasound biometry, CAMS and IMPACT-L combine shared image encoders with decoders specific to each task Li et al. (2026) ; Rasaee and Rivaz (2026) . Echo-CoPilot illustrates the use of learned measurement tools in a broader system for echocardiographic interpretation Heidari et al. (2025) . Our method instead derives endpoint queries from the representation of a clinical measurement question.
blocks.zh: 地标探测器通常预测预定义解剖点的坐标或热图. nnLandmark提供了三维地标探测的自定义方法,而MedSapians的适应则对医学影像Ertl等(2026年);Elbatel等(2026年)提出了估计表示. 对于超声波生物测量,CAMS和IMPACT-L结合了共享图像编码器和针对每项任务的解码器Li等(2026);Rasaee和Rivaz(2026). Echo-CoPilot说明了在更广泛的回声心学解释系统中使用已学习到的测量工具的情况。 相反,我们的方法从临床测量问题的代表性中得出了终点问题。

blocks.en: LISA uses a language model state to predict segmentation masks, while recent point grounding work predicts heatmaps from multimodal representations Lai et al. (2024) ; Jhang et al. (2026) . We build on this connection between language and spatial prediction, but focus on groups of caliper points whose geometry defines a clinical measurement. Kev is an open decision model trained on Qwen3.5 Palmer (2026) . We initialize the Qwen3.5 language model with the pretrained Kev adapter and train a separate pixel pointer to localize ultrasound landmarks.
blocks.zh: LISA使用一种语言模型状态来预测分解口罩,而最近的点地工作预测了从多模式表示Lai等人(2024年);Jhang等人(2026年)得到的热图. 我们基于语言和空间预测之间的这种联系,但侧重于几何定义临床测量的哈里发点群. Kev是一个开放的决定模式, 我们以预先训练的克夫适配器来初始化了Quen3.5语言模型,并训练出一个单独的像素指针来将超声波地标本地化.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Let I I be an ultrasound image of width W W and height H H , with a known anatomical view v v . Each view has a predefined set of clinical measurements ℳ ⁡ ( v ) \mathcal{M}(v) , where each measurement m ∈ ℳ ⁡ ( v ) m\in\mathcal{M}(v) is associated with a clinical question t m t_{m} and the number of required anatomical landmarks is K m ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 } K_{m}\in\{2,3,4\} . Kev-Bio predicts these landmarks and computes the corresponding measurements from their coordinates. As illustrated in Figure 1 , the model combines a multimodal language model with a shared dense visual feature map. The language model produces a decision representation for each measurement, which is then transformed into endpoint-specific queries for locating landmarks in the feature map.

Clinical questions are encoded into decision states at ⟨ decide ⟩ \langle\mathrm{decide}\rangle tokens, which generate queries for each landmark endpoint. A convolutional-based Pixel Neck combines features from the three visual encoders into a shared dense feature map. Endpoint queries are matched against this map to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived.

blocks.en:
Training jointly supervises the predicted landmark coordinates, their spatial probability maps, and the clinical measurement values calculated from these coordinates. The pointer loss ℒ ptr \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ptr}} calculates the L1 error between predicted and ground-truth landmark coordinates and normalizes it by the image diagonal length. The heatmap loss ℒ hm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{hm}} calculates the cross-entropy between the predicted spatial probability map and a normalized Gaussian distribution centered at the ground-truth landmark. This transforms point-based
landmark supervision into a continuous probability field,
encouraging high confidence near the true location while
allowing spatial uncertainty around it. The geometric loss ℒ geom \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{geom}} calculates the absolute error between the predicted and ground-truth measurement values and normalizes it by the training-set median of the corresponding measurement. An auxiliary regression head predicts endpoint coordinates and a measurement value directly from each decision state and uses Huber loss ℒ aux \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{aux}} to supervise both outputs. The complete objective is ℒ = ℒ ptr + λ hm ​ ℒ hm + λ geom ​ ℒ geom + λ aux ​ ℒ aux . \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ptr}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{hm}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{hm}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{geom}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{geom}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{aux}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{aux}}. (6) The auxiliary regression head provides additional supervision during training. During inference, the landmark coordinates and the corresponding measurement values are obtained from the pixel pointer and the geometric functions, respectively.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和执行细节

blocks.en: We evaluate Kev-Bio on the FU/GU Biometry 2026 benchmark, introduced at the MICCAI 2026 FoundUS challenge Bai et al. (2026) . The dataset spans nine ultrasound views across three clinical domains: cardiac, prenatal, and intrapartum imaging ( Table 1 ). The labelled benchmark contains 6,743 images, with 60 view-specific landmark definitions and 29 clinical measurements. These measurements include distances, ellipse circumferences, and angles, with each view requiring between one and eleven measurements. The dataset is highly imbalanced, ranging from 38 labelled images for IVC to 4,000 for AoP. An additional 191,170 unlabelled frames are provided but are not used in our experiments. Since the official challenge test annotations are unavailable for offline evaluation, we perform five-fold cross-validation on the labelled data, with approximately 1,350 images held out per fold. All methods are trained and evaluated using the same partitions.
blocks.zh: 我们对Kev-Bio进行FU/GU生物计量2026年基准的评估,该基准是在MICCAI 2026 FoundUS Challenge Bai等人(2026年)提出的。 该数据集涵盖9个超声波观测,涉及3个临床领域:心脏、产前和产后成像(表1)。 标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标 这些测量包括相距、椭圆和相角,每个视图需要1至11个测量。 数据集高度失衡,从IVC的38个标签图像到AoP的4000个. 提供了另外191 170个无标签的框架,但在我们的实验中没有使用。 由于正式的挑战测试说明无法进行离线评价,因此我们在贴有标签的数据上进行了5倍的交叉验证,每叠约1 350个图像被保留. 所有方法都经过培训和评估,使用相同的分区。

blocks.en: We initialize the language backbone from Kev Palmer (2026) , based on Qwen3.5-0.8B, and fine-tune it with LoRA adapters (r=16). The Qwen vision encoder and USFM are adapted with rank-16 LoRA, while DINOv2 ViT-L/14 uses rank-32. We set λ hm = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{hm}}=0.1 , λ geom = 0.2 \lambda_{\mathrm{geom}}=0.2 , and λ aux = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{aux}}=1 and train for 24 epochs using AdamW with a weight decay of 0.05 and an effective batch size of 8. Learning rates are 10 − 3 10^{-3} for newly initialized modules, 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the language model and DINOv2 adapters, and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for the remaining adapters. For all methods and baselines, we adopt the publicly released codebases and corresponding pretrained model weights. Training samples are drawn uniformly across the nine views, with photometric and affine augmentations following Panagiotakopoulou et al. (2026) . All experiments were conducted on NVIDIA H100 GPUs (80 GB GPU memory).

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Prior Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与以往方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare Kev-Bio with two general-purpose landmark detectors, nnLandmark Ertl et al. (2026) and MedSapiens Elbatel et al. (2026) , and four methods developed for the FU/GU Biometry challenge: CAMS Li et al. (2026) , IMPACT-L Rasaee and Rivaz (2026) , FMUB Wu et al. (2026) , and US-Foundation Panagiotakopoulou et al. (2026) . We report mean radial error (MRE) for landmark localization and mean absolute error (MAE) for clinical measurements, both in pixels (degrees for AoP) averaged across the nine views.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Kev-Bio和两个通用地标探测器:nnLandmark Ertl等人(2026年)和MedSapians Elbatel等人(2026年),以及针对FU/GU生物计量挑战制定的四种方法:CAMS Li等人(2026年)、IMPACT-L Rasaee和Rivaz(2026年)、FMUB Wu等人(2026年)和US-Foundation Panagiotakopoulou等人(2026年)。 我们报告标志性局部化的光圈误差(MRE)和临床测量的正绝对误差(MAE),均以像素(AoP的度)为平均值,分布于九景.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , Kev-Bio achieves the lowest average error on both metrics among the reported methods, with 22.50 pixels MRE and 15.38 MAE, compared with 23.88 and 17.47 for the strongest respective baselines. It achieves the best landmark localization on eight of the nine views and the lowest measurement error on six, spanning both cardiac and prenatal imaging, with a comparable parameter count. The improvement is particularly notable in fetal head biometry, where MRE decreases from 17.03 to 13.76 pixels. Notably, these results are obtained without using the additional unlabelled challenge data leveraged by CAMS and FMUB. Although competing methods achieve slightly lower measurement errors on femur length, cervical length, and angle of progression, Kev-Bio maintains the lowest average error across both metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse anatomical views and measurement tasks.
blocks.zh: 如表2所显示的,Kev-Bio在所报告的方法中实现了两个指标中最低的平均误差,分别为22.50像素MRE和15.38 MAE, 而最强的基准分别为23.88和17.47。 它在9个观点中的8个观点上实现了最佳地标本地化,在6个观点上实现了最小的测量误差,既包括心脏成像,也包括产前成像,参数计数可以比较. 胎头生物测量学的改进尤为显著,其中MRE从17.03到13.76像素. 值得注意的是,这些结果是在没有使用CAMS和FMUB利用的额外无标签挑战数据的情况下取得的。 虽然相竞方法在股骨长度,子宫颈长度和进取角度上实现了略低的测量误差,但Kev-Bio在两个度量衡中都保持了最低的平均误差,显示了它在不同解剖观点和测量任务上的有效性.

blocks.en: 4.3 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 定性结果

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents qualitative comparisons between Kev-Bio and US-Foundation Panagiotakopoulou et al. (2026) across all nine ultrasound views. Kev-Bio places most landmarks closer to their annotated anatomical targets, whereas US-Foundation shows larger localization errors, including predictions on neighboring structures. This is particularly evident in the IVC, fetal head, and femur examples, where substantial localization errors are observed for US-Foundation despite accurate predictions from Kev-Bio. In the A4C example containing adjacent cardiac views, Kev-Bio correctly identifies the target anatomy, while US-Foundation places several landmarks on the neighboring view. These examples illustrate the ability of text-conditioned spatial pointing to preserve anatomical correspondence across diverse ultrasound measurements.
blocks.zh: 图2列出了Kev-Bio与美国Panagiotakopoulou基金会(2026年)在所有9个超声波观测中的质量比较。 凯文 生物使大多数地标更接近其附加注释的解剖目标,而美国-基金会则显示出更大的本地化错误,包括对相邻结构的预测. 这一点在病媒、胎儿头和股股等例子中尤其明显,在这些例子中,尽管Kev-Bio作了准确的预测,但美国基金会仍然观察到实质性的局部化错误。 在包含相邻心脏视图的A4C实例中,克夫-比奥正确识别了目标解剖学,而美国-Foundation则在相邻视图上放置了多个地标. 这些例子说明了文字条件空间指向在各种超声波测量中保持解剖对应的能力.

blocks.en: Beyond landmark localization, Kev-Bio produces a spatial probability map for each endpoint ( Figure 3 a), whose entropy serves as an uncertainty score. To assess whether this score identifies localization failures, we consider predictions more than 5% of the image diagonal from ground truth as errors. We then rank predictions by decreasing entropy and measure the fraction of errors captured among the highest-ranked predictions ( Figure 3 b). Inspecting the 10% most uncertain predictions captures 40% of errors, compared with 10% under random selection. Error detection AUROCs reach 0.70, 0.76, and 0.86 for cardiac, prenatal, and intrapartum imaging, respectively. These results suggest that Kev-Bio’s probability maps can help clinicians identify caliper placements that warrant closer inspection, enabling more targeted verification of automated measurements.
blocks.zh: 除了地标本地化外,Kev-Bio还绘制出每个端点的空间概率图(图3 a),其 en能作为不确定性分. 为了评估这个分数是否识别出本地化失败,我们认为预测超过5%的图像从地面真理对角是错误. 然后,我们通过降低等效度来对预测进行排序,并测量在排名最高的预测中捕获出错的比例(图3b)。 检查10%最不确定的预测能捕捉出40%的误差,而随机选择的误差为10%. 心脏、产前和产后成像的AUROC分别达到0.70、0.76和0.86。 这些结果表明,Kev-Bio的概率图可以帮助临床医生确定需要更密切检查的卡利佩位置,从而能够更有针对性的核查自动化测量。

Errors are defined using ground truth as deviations exceeding 5% of the image diagonal. The black marker indicates the overall result, and the dashed line represents random selection.

blocks.en: Finally, Figure 4 visualizes how clinical questions guide spatial localization. Given the same ultrasound image, different measurement questions produce distinct probability maps that concentrate on the corresponding anatomical landmarks. In A4C, for example, queries for ventricular length and atrial width highlight different anatomical endpoints, while related fetal head measurements yield consistent responses at shared landmarks. These observations illustrate how Kev-Bio adapts its spatial predictions to different measurement definitions through a shared, question-conditioned pixel pointer.
blocks.zh: 最后,图4可视化了临床问题如何引导空间定位. 鉴于同样的超声波图像,不同的测量问题产生出独特的概率图来集中研究相应的解剖地标. 例如,在A4C中,对口腔长度和审判宽度的询问突出了不同的解剖端点,而相关的胎儿头部测量在共享地标上产生一致的响应. 这些观测结果说明了Kev-Bio如何通过一个共享,有问题条件的像素指针来使其空间预测适应不同的测量定义.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Question-conditioned landmark localization. Different clinical measurement questions produce distinct landmark probability maps on the same ultrasound image. Green circles denote ground truth, and yellow regions indicate predicted spatial distributions.
blocks.zh: 图4:有条件的地标化. 不同的临床测量问题在同一超声波图像上产生了独特的地标概率图. 绿色圆圈表示地面真理,而黄色区域则表示预测的空间分布.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: We assess the contribution of each component by retraining model variants under identical settings, as reported in Table 3 . Removing the pixel pointer (replacing spatial localization with direct coordinate regression from the decision states) leads to the largest performance degradation, increasing MRE from 22.50 to 35.50 pixels and MAE from 15.38 to 23.64. This highlights the importance of matching measurement-specific queries to dense spatial features rather than directly regressing coordinates from the decision states. Removing DINOv2 also reduces performance, yielding 24.85 MRE and 16.94 MAE, indicating the benefit of complementary visual representations for precise landmark localization. Excluding the language model (LLM) and replacing its decision states with learned, image-conditioned measurement queries results in a smaller but consistent increase in error (23.66 MRE and 16.77 MAE), suggesting that language-conditioned queries contribute to localization accuracy even when measurement definitions are fixed.
blocks.zh: 如表3所报告,我们通过在相同环境下的再培训模式变体评估每个组成部分的贡献。 移除像素指针(将空间局部化与直接坐标回归从决定状态相取代)会导致最大的性能退化,使MRE从22.50到35.50像素,MAE从15.38到23.64. 这突出表明了将特定测量查询与密集的空间地貌相匹配的重要性,而不是将坐标从决定状态直接递回。 删除 DINov2 也会降低性能,产生24.85 MRE和16.94 MAE,表明互补视觉表现对精确地标本地化的好处. 排除了语言模型(LLM),取而代之的是其决定状态的有学有学的,以图像为条件的测量查询导致出错(23.66 MRE和16.77 MAE)较小而持续地增加,这表明,即使测量定义是固定的,也以语言为条件的查询有助于本地化准确性.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Kev-Bio offers a unified approach to ultrasound biometry by handling different clinical measurements through a shared localization framework, as opposed to task-specific prediction heads. Beyond predicting landmark coordinates, its spatial probability maps provide information about ambiguous predictions, potentially helping clinicians identify caliper placements that require verification. Nevertheless, our evaluation is limited to predefined measurements on a single benchmark, despite spanning multiple anatomical regions. Generalization to unseen measurement instructions, anatomical structures, and different imaging conditions remains to be explored. Future work will investigate these directions, alongside uncertainty calibration and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: Kev-Bio通过共享本地化框架处理不同的临床测量,而不是任务特定预测头,为超声波生物测量提供了统一的方法. 其空间概率图除了预测地标坐标外,还提供模棱两可的预测信息,有可能帮助临床医生确定需要核查的哈里发位置. 然而,我们的评价仅限于在单一基准上预先确定的计量,尽管涉及多个解剖区域。 对隐形测量指令、解剖结构以及不同成像条件的概括仍有待探索。 今后的工作将对这些方向以及不确定性校准和计算效率进行调查。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Kev-Bio, a System One framework that formulates medical ultrasound biometry as spatial decision-making. By grounding clinical measurement questions in dense visual features, the model localizes anatomical landmarks and derives clinical measurements within a unified framework. Experiments across nine ultrasound views demonstrate improvements over existing methods, while the predicted probability maps provide additional information about localization ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Kev-Bio,一个系统一框架,将医学超声波生物测量作为空间决策. 通过将临床测量问题以密集的视觉特征定位,模型将解剖地标本地化,并在统一的框架内得到临床测量. 跨越9个超声波观测观点的实验表明比起现有方法有所改进,而预测概率图则提供了本地化模糊性的额外信息.
